title: Coffee project
tagline: The Coffee Project is dedicated to monitoring the influence of local communities who organize both online and offline events. Leveraging EAS and Worldcoin, we ensure the authenticity and accuracy of the data collected.
description: The Coffee Project is a groundbreaking initiative deeply committed to understanding and monitoring the profound impact of local communities that actively engage in organizing events, both in the digital realm and the physical world. By harnessing the power of cutting-edge technologies such as EAS and the renowned Worldcoin platform, we go beyond mere data collection. Our team prioritizes ensuring that every piece of information we gather is not only authentic but also maintains the highest degree of accuracy. Our dedication stems from a firm belief in the importance of community interactions, and we strive to offer a comprehensive view of their ripple effects in today's interconnected society.
how_its_made: While the process is still underway, I've incorporated the use of Worldcoin to ensure that real, authentic human beings are behind each verification. Additionally, I utilize the advanced capabilities of EAS to submit incontrovertible proof of each verification made. This dual-layered approach guarantees the highest standard of authenticity and accountability in our system.
